description:
Plugin for text processing tasks using machine learning:
(parameter documentation for all APIs is provided)


Image generation from text
Input text as a parameter in the API call and receive image as data in the UI.

Abstractive summarization of text(generates new text as summary)
The key text holds the value defined by user that is sent during this API call which returns data that can be accessed in the UI

Extractive text summarization from web pages and input texts

Language detection and translation.
Specify source language and target language as keys in translation API
Entity extraction
Sentiment Analysis

Autocorrect
Data is received as an action in the user's workflow.

connect to our numerous APIs and receive response as JSON. The response will come as data in your website once plugin is connected and request data initialized. Request data will be initialized at the property editor. Appropriate documentation for each parameter required is provided
name: TextAi
